title: Zoning text change for Park Avenue rezoning, Bedford-Stuyvesant
summary: This application would amend the Zoning Resolution to establish a Mandatory Inclusionary Housing area along Park Avenue in Bedford-Stuyvesant, Brooklyn, in conjunction with a related zoning map change. Together the actions would allow ten new buildings of five to 11 stories with 391 housing units, 101 of them permanently income-restricted, plus commercial and school space. The Council approved the plan with modifications on October 8, 2026.
